threads.author: Stephenie Yong
threads.summary: Livit Jotform confirmation emails render dates as mm/dd/yy instead of the international dd/mm/yy, and preferred scan time isn't a required field on the Jotform, so confirmations come through showing 12:00 AM.
threads.note: Stephenie confirmed she'll wait for updates — next action is on the CS Apps team to fix the date format and make preferred scan time compulsory on the Livit Jotform.

threads.author: Juyoung Jang
threads.summary: Airbnb jobs are not appearing in the Capture Techs' views, even for jobs that are already scheduled. Also asked whether the reminder email to Airbnb hosts on "Please Schedule" jobs is actually going out.
threads.note: Root cause for the "Please Schedule" jobs is that they are unassigned, but Juyoung said she would send links to scheduled Airbnb jobs that still aren't visible — waiting on those examples before COP-2043 can move.
